text: Kalshi is a prediction-market company; its own May 2026 announcement names Tarek Mansour as co-founder and CEO, and states that its $1 billion Series F round at a $22 billion valuation was led by Coatue, with participation from Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, Paradigm, Morgan Stanley and ARK Invest.
short: Kalshi's announced backers are US venture and investment firms; Tarek Mansour is co-founder and CEO.

source.name: Kalshi News: 'Kalshi Raises $1 Billion at a $22 Billion Valuation as Institutional Adoption Accelerates'
source.quote: announced a $1 billion Series F round at a $22 billion valuation, led by Coatue, with participation from Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, Paradigm, Morgan Stanley, and ARK Invest
